openalex.scope: Anonymous recent-publication poll of Computer Science field 17; staged candidates only
openalex.publication: Not published: embeddings, assignments, drift and relevance gates still required

ledger.publication: staged only; build, integrity and relevance gates required before promotion

limitations: Overlapping 14-day window; may miss late-indexed and older corrected/retracted work.
Maximum 500 source rows; dense publication periods are truncated.
No automatic promotion to the public snapshot.

crossref.scope: Deposited abstracts only; citation counts are Crossref counts, not OpenAlex counts.

limitations: Bounded recent windows, not complete historical/retraction synchronization.
arXiv does not supply citation counts; Crossref/OpenAlex counts are different measures.
An unavailable source aborts promotion; the previous release remains served.
